payload.name: Descope
payload.description: 为应用和 MCP 添加身份验证
payload.summaryOriginal: Add auth to your apps and MCPs
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Descope brings a first-class authentication and identity management experience into ChatGPT. Manage users, tenants, roles, and access control across your Descope projects through natural language. Build and modify auth flows for signup, login, MFA, SSO, and federation without leaving the conversation. Configure auth, consent, and credential management for your MCP servers and AI agents, and easily search Descope documentation when you need guidance.
payload.longDescription: Descope 将一流的身份验证与身份管理体验带入 ChatGPT。通过自然语言管理 Descope 项目中的用户、租户、角色和访问控制。无需离开对话，即可构建和修改注册、登录、多因素身份验证（MFA）、单点登录（SSO）和身份联合流程。为 MCP 服务器和 AI 代理配置身份验证、用户同意及凭据管理；需要指导时，还可以轻松搜索 Descope 文档。

payload.name: Brainbase MCP
payload.description: 构建和运营AI智能体
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Brainbase MCP lets users create, inspect, update, test, deploy, and monitor managed AI agents from ChatGPT and Codex. It supports revision-safe agent changes, registry skills and MCP server configuration, evaluations, orchestrations, schedules, and task runs, with explicit confirmation for destructive actions and OAuth-based access to the user's Brainbase workspace.
payload.longDescription: Brainbase MCP让用户通过ChatGPT和Codex创建、查看、更新、测试、部署和监控托管AI智能体。它支持能安全处理版本修订的智能体变更、注册表技能和MCP服务器配置、评估、编排、计划安排和任务运行，破坏性操作需要明确确认，并通过基于OAuth的访问连接用户的Brainbase工作空间。

payload.name: Ezoic Setup
payload.description: 在网站上设置 Ezoic 广告
payload.summaryOriginal: Set up Ezoic ads on your site
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Ezoic Setup helps publishers and developers implement Ezoic ads on any site. Ask a question in plain language and it answers with working, copyable code grounded in Ezoic's official documentation, SDKs, and examples - ad placeholders, showAds calls, SPA route-change handling, consent (Gatekeeper) scripts, WordPress and Next.js/React integrations, ads.txt setup, and troubleshooting. It covers JavaScript, React, Vue, Angular, WordPress, and raw HTML sites, and always recommends the cleanest supported integration path for your stack. No account is required to ask questions.
payload.longDescription: Ezoic Setup 帮助发布商和开发者在任何网站上集成 Ezoic 广告。用普通语言提问，它会根据 Ezoic 官方文档、SDK 和示例，给出可运行且可复制的代码，涵盖广告占位符、showAds 调用、SPA 路由切换处理、同意管理（Gatekeeper）脚本、WordPress 和 Next.js/React 集成、ads.txt 设置及故障排查。它支持 JavaScript、React、Vue、Angular、WordPress 和原生 HTML 网站，并始终为你的技术栈推荐最简洁且受支持的集成方式。提问无需账户。

payload.name: Git Diff Patcher Bridge
payload.description: 安全审查 AI 代码补丁
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Git Diff Patcher Bridge connects ChatGPT to GDP through a privacy-bounded MCP endpoint. It can inspect selected repository context, diagnose patches, read local verification evidence, coordinate durable development state, classify restart requirements, compose private evidence-linked Wire drafts, and create reviewable local requests. The hosted connector does not directly apply patches, execute arbitrary shell commands, force-push code, publish public content, or bypass GDP Desktop authority. Repository-changing actions remain behind GDP Desktop review and local execution boundaries. The connector also supports a seeded Demo Workspace for zero-install reviewer and user evaluation.
payload.longDescription: Git Diff Patcher Bridge 通过受隐私范围限制的 MCP 端点，将 ChatGPT 连接到 GDP。它可以检查选定的代码仓库上下文、诊断补丁、读取本地验证证据、协调持久化开发状态、判定重启要求、撰写带私密证据链接的 Wire 草稿，并创建可供审查的本地请求。托管连接器不会直接应用补丁、执行任意 shell 命令、强制推送代码、发布公开内容，也不会绕过 GDP Desktop 的权限控制。所有更改代码仓库的操作仍须经过 GDP Desktop 审查和本地执行边界。连接器还提供预置的 Demo Workspace，供审查者和用户免安装体验。

payload.name: API Documentation Checker
payload.description: 检查 API 文档
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Extract API contract details, check whether documentation covers the stated API contract, and compare API contract versions. Results are structured, evidence-based, and limited to explicitly provided information.
payload.longDescription: 提取 API 契约详情，检查文档是否涵盖声明的 API 契约，并比较 API 契约版本。结果结构化、以证据为依据，并仅限于明确提供的信息。

payload.name: Manufact
payload.description: 部署和管理MCP服务器
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Manufact lets users deploy, monitor, and manage MCP servers and MCP Apps in Manufact Cloud. The app supports organization lookup, server and deployment management, GitHub repository deployment, build and runtime log inspection, and gateway observability analytics.
payload.longDescription: Manufact允许用户在Manufact Cloud中部署、监控和管理MCP服务器及MCP应用。该应用支持组织查询、服务器和部署管理、GitHub仓库部署、构建和运行时日志检查，以及网关可观测性分析。

payload.name: Charming
payload.description: AI构建应用的安全云平台
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Charming is a hosted runtime for personal web apps that users and their agents can share. An agent creates an app, Charming gives it a URL, backend, and key-value storage, and the user keeps using the same app and data across ChatGPT, Claude, and other agents.
payload.longDescription: Charming是个人网页应用的托管运行时，用户及其代理可以共享该应用。代理创建应用后，Charming会为其分配URL、后端服务和键值存储，用户可在ChatGPT、Claude及其他代理中持续使用同一应用和数据。

payload.name: Alpic
payload.description: 监测 MCP 应用和服务器
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Manage your projects, debug deployment, and check analytics for any MCP server you host with Alpic.
payload.longDescription: 管理项目、调试部署，并查看你通过 Alpic 托管的任何 MCP 服务器的分析数据。

payload.name: Quicknode
payload.description: 面向 OpenAI 构建者的 Quicknode
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Manage your Quicknode infrastructure directly in OpenAI. Create and manage endpoints, monitor logs and usage, configure security and rate limits, and review billing from one conversation.
payload.longDescription: 直接在 OpenAI 中管理 Quicknode 基础设施。在一次对话中创建和管理端点、监控日志与用量、配置安全性和速率限制，并查看账单。

payload.name: Prismic
payload.description: 管理 Prismic 内容
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Prismic MCP lets users list accessible Prismic repositories, inspect content models (custom types and slices), search and fetch documents, and make release-scoped content changes by creating releases, creating documents, updating documents, and uploading assets to the repository asset library.
payload.longDescription: Prismic MCP 可让用户列出有权访问的 Prismic 存储库、检查内容模型（自定义类型和切片）、搜索并获取文档，以及在指定发布版本范围内进行内容更改，包括创建发布版本、创建文档、更新文档并向存储库的资源库上传文件。

payload.name: MiniUp
payload.description: 将聊天转化为实时网络应用
payload.summaryOriginal: Turn chat into live web apps
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: MiniUp helps users publish simple, modular single-page, and real multi-page no-build web apps from ChatGPT-generated files or uploaded data, host fast queryable datasets and lightweight table APIs, publish ArcGIS-compatible dataset URLs, and manage existing sites, files, gallery listings, records, and datasets from ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: MiniUp帮助用户从ChatGPT生成的文件或上传数据中发布简单、模块化的单页应用和真正的多页无构建网页应用，托管快速可查询的数据集和轻量级表格API，发布与ArcGIS兼容的数据集URL，并从ChatGPT管理现有网站、文件、画廊列表、记录和数据集。

payload.name: Sitelemetry
payload.description: 审计并改进网站
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Sitelemetry audits websites across security, technical SEO, AI visibility, analytics and tracking integrations, accessibility, and performance. It returns prioritized findings with evidence, impact, and concrete remediation guidance. Public, non-intrusive checks can assess public websites; protected security modules and full audits require a verified Sitelemetry project. Connections use OAuth with PKCE, and private-network targets are blocked. A Sitelemetry account is required; available audits and usage limits reflect the access already assigned to the connected account.
payload.longDescription: Sitelemetry 会从安全、技术 SEO、AI 可见度、分析和跟踪集成、无障碍及性能等方面审计网站，并按优先级返回发现的问题，附上证据、影响和具体修复建议。它可对公开网站进行公开且非侵入式检查；受保护的安全模块和完整审计需要已验证的 Sitelemetry 项目。连接使用带 PKCE 的 OAuth，并会拦截私有网络目标。需要 Sitelemetry 账户；可用审计功能和使用限制取决于已关联账户所获权限。

payload.name: Pathors
payload.description: 构建并部署语音智能体
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Build and deploy production-ready voice AI agents in minutes — no coding required.
payload.longDescription: 几分钟内即可构建并部署可用于生产环境的语音 AI 智能体——无需编写代码。

payload.name: Sprites
payload.description: 为 Codex 配备自己的电脑
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Give your agent its own computer with safety and security. Sprites from Fly are isolated cloud environments with their own filesystem, URL, services, checkpoints, and network policy. This plugin connects Codex to the Sprites MCP server so Codex can manage those remote environments easily.
payload.longDescription: 让智能体拥有一台安全可靠的专属计算机。Fly 的 Sprites 是隔离的云环境，拥有各自的文件系统、URL、服务、检查点和网络策略。此插件将 Codex 连接到 Sprites MCP 服务器，便于 Codex 轻松管理这些远程环境。

payload.name: Vantage
payload.description: 分析云成本
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Vantage is the system of record for allocating and optimizing cloud, SaaS, and AI costs. Vantage has multiple tools for optimizing cloud spend and provides organizations with advanced FinOps workflows and cost governance.
payload.longDescription: Vantage 是用于分摊和优化云、SaaS 及 AI 成本的记录系统。Vantage 提供多种云支出优化工具，并为组织提供高级 FinOps 工作流程和成本治理能力。

payload.name: AICtrl
payload.description: 工程技能与工作流程
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: aictrl.dev helps engineering teams inspect project context and backlogs, discover governed workflows, start versioned workflow runs, review run evidence, decide approval gates, and cancel active runs through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: aictrl.dev通过ChatGPT帮助工程团队检查项目背景和待办事项，发现受监管的工作流程，启动版本化工作流运行，审查运行证据，决定审批节点，并取消活动运行。

payload.name: Nimble
payload.description: 面向代理的专家级网页搜索
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Nimble gives agents governed, accurate access to the public web, at a lower token cost per answer. Search finds current pages with ranked results and snippets. Extract returns clean, structured content from any URL, including pages needing JavaScript or interaction. Extraction Templates give consistently shaped records from known sites. Web Search Agents handle open-ended work across many sources, returning findings with citations, for research, enrichment, and dataset building.

Also included: ready-made workflows for competitor research, company profiles, meeting prep, market discovery, brand monitoring, SEO, and talent sourcing.
payload.longDescription:
Nimble 以每个答案更低的令牌成本，为代理提供受治理且准确的公共网络访问。Search 会返回带排名结果和摘要的当前页面；Extract 可从任何 URL 提取干净、结构化的内容，包括需要 JavaScript 或交互的页面。Extraction Templates 可从已知网站持续返回形状一致的记录。Web Search Agents 可跨多个来源处理开放式任务，并以引用返回发现，用于研究、丰富和数据集构建。

还包括竞争对手研究、公司画像、会议准备、市场发现、品牌监测、SEO 和人才寻源等现成工作流。

payload.name: Magic Patterns
payload.description: 获取设计灵感
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Enable your agent to prototype ideas, generate design inspiration, upload local UI, and integrate Magic Patterns designs. The Magic Patterns toolset lets you visually align with your agent on what you want to build.
payload.longDescription: 让你的智能体能够制作创意原型、生成设计灵感、上传本地 UI，并整合 Magic Patterns 设计。Magic Patterns 工具集可帮助你与智能体通过视觉方式确认想要构建的内容。

payload.name: emem
payload.description: 关于真实地点的签名事实
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: emem answers place-based questions with signed Earth-observation and geospatial facts. It can resolve a place, retrieve or materialize available facts, provide verifiable citations, compare similar places, and verify signed receipts.
payload.longDescription: emem 使用经过签名的地球观测和地理空间事实回答地点相关问题。它可以解析地点、检索或生成可用事实、提供可验证的引用、比较相似地点，并验证签名回执。

payload.name: Metaplay SDK Docs
payload.description: 搜索 Metaplay SDK 文档
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Metaplay SDK Docs gives ChatGPT access to Metaplay's LLM-optimized documentation corpus, including SDK source files, sample projects, release notes, CLI reference, and website content across multiple SDK versions. Users can ask natural-language questions and the app retrieves the most relevant articles, reads specific files at requested line ranges, runs ripgrep regex searches, and globs for files by pattern.
payload.longDescription: Metaplay SDK Docs 让 ChatGPT 可以访问经过 LLM 优化的 Metaplay 文档语料库，其中包括 SDK 源文件、示例项目、发行说明、CLI 参考资料，以及多个 SDK 版本的网站内容。用户可以用自然语言提问，应用会检索最相关的文章、按要求的行范围读取特定文件、运行 ripgrep 正则表达式搜索，并按模式使用 glob 匹配文件。

payload.name: Garchi CMS
payload.description: 管理网站和社交媒体内容
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Garchi CMS is a headless SaaS CMS used to manage content across platforms such as websites and apps. With this app, you could connect to Garchi CMS using the MCP server and manage your platform's content levaraging the power of Chat GPT.

Example prompts
- Create a blog article on best principles of Gen AI using Garchi CMS
- Create a landing page using the provided brief in Garchi CMS.

Garchi CMS是一款无头SaaS内容管理系统，用于管理网站和应用程序等跨平台内容。
通过该应用，您可以使用MCP服务器连接至Garchi CMS，并利用Chat GPT的强大功能管理平台内容。

示例提示
- 使用Garchi CMS创建一篇关于生成式AI最佳原则的博客文章
- 使用Garchi CMS中提供的简报创建落地页。

payload.name: Mnemom
payload.description: 代理互联网的信任基础设施
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Mnemom is trust infrastructure built for agents, not just the humans who run them. In one chat you can look up an agent's Continuous Trust Rating — the score, the grade, and the accountability evidence behind it — and confirm it's cryptographically signed, not merely asserted. Drop your own alignment card and get an instant trust read back; claim a verifiable identity with no human in the loop; and walk away with an embeddable Trust Rating badge for your README or agent card. Every read is honest about what it knows: a quiet record reads as quiet, never as a red flag. The system tells the truth — and view-source proves it.
payload.longDescription: Mnemom 是为代理构建的信任基础设施，也服务于运行代理的人类。在一次聊天中查找代理的持续信任评级，包括分数、等级及背后的问责证据，并确认它经过加密签名而非仅凭声称。提交自己的对齐卡即可立即获得信任解读；无需人工介入即可认领可验证身份；还可获得可嵌入 README 或代理卡的信任评级徽章。每次读取都会诚实说明已知范围：安静的记录就显示为安静，绝不会被当作危险信号。系统如实呈现，查看源代码即可验证。

payload.name: @imqueue
payload.description: 搜索文档，生成代码
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
@imqueue is an open-source TypeScript framework for building microservices that
talk over a message queue instead of HTTP — you write a class, decorate the
methods you want to publish, and callers get a fully-typed client generated from
the running service.

This server gives your assistant first-hand knowledge of it, so it writes real
@imqueue code instead of plausible-looking code.

search_docs covers the guides, the tutorial, the CLI manual, the articles, and
every exported symbol of every @imqueue package that publishes an API reference —
so you can ask a question in plain words ("how do I expose a service method?") or
look up an exact signature ("RedisQueue.send", "IMQOptions.safeDelivery"). It
ranks with the same engine imqueue.org's own search uses, so the site and this
server agree about which page answers a question, and licensing and pricing
questions answer from imqueue.com rather than the framework docs. A result can
point at a section rather than a whole page, and get_doc follows that anchor:
give it a URL with a #fragment and it returns just that section, with the heading
path above it and its position on the page, so you can see what was left out and
ask for the rest. Without a fragment it returns the whole page as plain markdown
for reading and quoting. list_packages returns the current package catalogue with
install commands, which is how an assistant picks the right one rather than
guessing at a name. Where two packages cover the same ground — tracing, or the
database layer — the results carry the rule for choosing exactly one, because
installing both breaks quietly rather than loudly.

package_status answers the version question outright: the current version,
licence, minimum Node version and release date of one @imqueue package or of all
of them, read from imqueue.org at the moment you ask rather than recalled. It
also answers for the framework as a whole — the Node and Redis floors, and a
licence note that states the licence terms in a sentence.

scaffold_service generates an idiomatic service — an IMQService subclass with
@expose()d, JSDoc-typed methods plus a bootstrap that starts it — from the method
signatures you describe. A custom return type comes back with the @classType() and
@property() decorators it needs, which matters because a field that lacks them
reaches the generated client typed any and still compiles. scaffold_client shows
how to generate and use the typed client for a service. Both return source text
for you to review and paste; neither writes a file.

All seven tools are read-only. The server has no accounts, no authentication and
no storage: each request is handled statelessly, and the only data it sees is the
argument you send — a search query, a doc URL, a package or service name. Nothing
is retained, and no conversation content is collected or used for training.

Tools that would act on your own machine — driving the imq CLI, creating projects
on disk, starting and stopping your services, reading their logs — are
deliberately not part of this server, because a hosted server cannot reach your
machine and should not claim to. They ship in the local install instead
(npx -y @imqueue/mcp), and local_install_guide returns the setup steps for it.
payload.longDescription:
@imqueue 是一个开源 TypeScript 框架，用于构建通过消息队列而非 HTTP 通信的微服务——您只需编写一个类，对希望公开的方法添加装饰器，调用方将获得从运行中的服务生成的完整类型客户端。

此服务器让您的助手获得第一手知识，因此它会生成真正的@imqueue 代码，而非看起来合理的代码。

search_docs 覆盖指南、教程、CLI 手册、文章以及所有@imqueue 包的导出符号，这些包都提供了 API 参考——因此您可以用自然语言提问（“如何公开服务方法？”）或查找精确的签名（“RedisQueue.send”，“IMQOptions.safeDelivery”）。它使用与 imqueue.org 自身搜索相同的引擎，因此网站和此服务器对问题答案的判断一致，而许可和定价问题则从 imqueue.com 回答而非框架文档。结果可指向页面内的具体章节，get_doc 会跟随该锚点：提供带 #fragment 的 URL 时，它将返回该章节内容，包含上方的标题路径和页面中的位置，方便查看遗漏部分并请求剩余内容。不带 fragment 时则以纯文本格式返回整页内容，便于阅读和引用。list_packages 返回当前的包目录及安装命令，这正是助手选择正确包而非猜测名称的方式。当两个包覆盖相同领域——如追踪或数据库层——结果会携带明确的选包规则，因为
同时安装两者会静默失败而非发出警告。

package_status 直接回答版本问题：某个@imqueue 包或所有包的当前版本、许可证、最低 Node 版本和发布日期，数据来自您提问时的 imqueue.org 而非记忆。它同时回答框架整体信息——Node 和 Redis 的版本要求，以及用一句话说明许可证条款的许可证说明。

scaffold_service 会根据您描述的方法签名生成符合规范的服务——一个带有@expose()装饰的 JSDoc 类型方法的 IMQService 子类，以及启动它的引导代码。自定义返回类型会携带生成客户端所需的@classType()和@property()装饰器，这一点很重要，因为缺少这些装饰器的字段在生成的客户端中会被视为 any 类型但仍能编译通过。scaffold_client 展示了如何为服务生成和使用类型客户端。两者都会返回源代码文本供您查看和粘贴；两者都不会写入文件。

所有七个工具均为只读模式。服务器不包含账户、认证或存储功能：每个请求均无状态处理，服务器看到的唯一数据是您发送的参数——搜索查询、文档 URL、包或服务名称。不会保留任何数据，也不会收集或使用对话内容进行训练。

那些需要在您本地机器上运行的工具——例如操作imq命令行界面、在磁盘上创建项目、启动和停止服务、读取日志等——被有意排除在该服务器之外，因为托管服务器无法访问您的机器，也不应声称具备此能力。这些工具实际通过本地安装提供（npx -y @imqueue/mcp），本地安装指南则提供了相应的设置步骤。

payload.name: FlawPilot
payload.description: 网站安全与 SEO 扫描器
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: FlawPilot connects ChatGPT to your website health scans. Ask ChatGPT to scan any live URL, and FlawPilot checks it for security vulnerabilities, performance bottlenecks, infrastructure issues, and SEO problems. ChatGPT can list your existing projects, start a new scan, and check scan status until results are ready with prioritized scores and actionable insights, all without leaving your conversation.
payload.longDescription: FlawPilot 将 ChatGPT 连接到你的网站健康扫描。让 ChatGPT 扫描任意在线 URL，FlawPilot 就会检查安全漏洞、性能瓶颈、基础设施问题和 SEO 问题。无需离开对话，ChatGPT 就可以列出你现有的项目、启动新扫描，并持续检查扫描状态，直到结果就绪；结果会包含优先级评分和可执行的洞察。

payload.name: NORMS: Evidence & Scope
payload.description: 结构化证据检查
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: NORMS assesses whether structured, ratified normative records have sufficient verified grounds for a declared purpose. It checks explicit authority, temporal applicability, scope, verification, provision segmentation and structured conditions, then reports blockers, unknowns and unexamined areas. Missing or unverified required grounds fail closed. NORMS does not provide legal advice, certify compliance, parse PDFs or documents, retrieve laws, infer normative conditions from free text, approve contracts or modify external data.
payload.longDescription: NORMS 用于评估结构化且已批准的规范记录，是否为已声明用途提供了充分且经过验证的依据。它会检查明确授权、时间适用性、范围、验证、条款拆分和结构化条件，然后报告阻塞项、未知事项和未经检查的领域。缺少所需依据或依据未经验证时，系统将拒绝放行。NORMS 不提供法律建议或合规认证，不解析 PDF 或其他文档，不检索法律，不会从自由文本推断规范条件，也不批准合同或修改外部数据。

payload.name: StubEngine
payload.description: 启动实时 API 模拟
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
StubEngine helps companies speed up API delivery by turning plain-English requirements into live API mocks. Users can generate valid mock APIs and manage everything in a shared business workspace.
Whether you need a single mocked endpoint or a full API project with related endpoints, StubEngine makes it faster to prototype, test and ship integrations.
By reducing manual setup and accelerating mock creation, teams can move from idea to working API simulation in minutes.
payload.longDescription:
StubEngine 帮助企业将通俗语言描述的需求转化为实时 API 模拟，从而加快 API 交付。用户可以生成有效的模拟 API，并在共享业务工作区中统一管理。
无论你需要模拟单个端点，还是包含相关端点的完整 API 项目，StubEngine 都能加快集成的原型设计、测试和发布。
通过减少手动设置并加快模拟创建，团队可以在几分钟内从想法推进到可运行的 API 模拟。

payload.name: Agent Community
payload.description: 成员查询和 DMV 工具
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Look up a known Agent Community member by exact name or slug, read the roughly-live community count, explicitly pre-register a proposed .agent identity, and verify live DMV certificate issuance. Broad directory search is intentionally unsupported. Pre-registration is free and non-binding, does not confer domain ownership, and the proposed .agent TLD remains pending ICANN approval.
payload.longDescription: 通过准确姓名或 slug 查询已知的 Agent Community 成员，读取近实时社区人数，明确预注册拟议的 .agent 身份，并核验实时 DMV 证书签发情况。应用有意不支持广泛的目录搜索。预注册免费且不具约束力，不授予域名所有权，拟议的 .agent 顶级域名仍在等待 ICANN 批准。

payload.name: SiteTriage
payload.description: 查明网站故障原因
payload.summaryOriginal: Find out why a site is broken
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Your site just broke — ask SiteTriage why. Give it a URL or domain and it runs live, read-only diagnostics from the edge: DNS resolution and propagation, the exact TLS certificate the server is presenting right now (including TLS 1.3), HTTP status and redirect chains, email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), and domain registration and expiry. It then returns the most likely root cause, ranked, with concrete fix steps — instead of guesses. Ideal for the deploy moment: apex-vs-www misconfigurations, stale DNS after a host migration, propagation lag, certificate errors, redirect loops, and emails landing in spam. Stateless and anonymous: no accounts, no stored data.
payload.longDescription: 网站刚刚出故障？问问 SiteTriage。提供 URL 或域名后，它会从网络边缘运行实时只读诊断：DNS 解析与传播情况、服务器当前提供的确切 TLS 证书（包括 TLS 1.3）、HTTP 状态码和重定向链、邮件身份验证（SPF、DKIM、DMARC），以及域名注册和到期时间。随后它会对最可能的根本原因进行排序，并提供具体修复步骤，而不是猜测。适合部署时排查：主域名与 www 配置错误、迁移主机后的 DNS 过期、传播延迟、证书错误、重定向循环，以及邮件进入垃圾邮件。无状态且匿名：无需账户，不存储数据。

payload.name: omgskills
payload.description: 查找可信的智能体技能
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Discover skills for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other coding agents from the omgskills public catalog. Search by task, inspect detailed metadata and installation instructions, browse trending and editorially selected skills, and explore skills from specific creators. omgskills is read-only: it helps people find and evaluate skills without installing or changing anything on their device.
payload.longDescription: 从 omgskills 公共目录中发现适用于 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 和其他编程智能体的技能。按任务搜索、查看详细元数据和安装说明、浏览热门及编辑精选技能，也可探索特定创作者的技能。omgskills 仅提供只读功能，帮助用户发现和评估技能，不会在设备上安装或更改任何内容。

payload.name: Alloy
payload.description: 分析机器人集群数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Alloy connects ChatGPT to your organization's robot mission and Mesh Storage data. Search missions and images, inspect summaries, reports, scenarios, devices, and data-lake tables, run read-only analysis, create reports and artifacts, manage report automations, and perform approved device or edge-configuration actions.
payload.longDescription: Alloy将ChatGPT连接到组织的机器人任务和Mesh Storage数据。搜索任务和图片，查看摘要、报告、场景、设备和数据湖表，运行只读分析，创建报告和文件，管理报告自动化，并执行获批准的设备或边缘配置操作。

payload.name: Noodle Seed
payload.description: 监控你的 MCP 应用
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Access your Noodle Seed workspace in ChatGPT to find information faster, stay organized, and keep your work moving without switching tools.
payload.longDescription: 在 ChatGPT 中访问你的 Noodle Seed 工作区，更快查找信息、保持井然有序，并在无需切换工具的情况下推进工作。

payload.name: zeroheight
payload.description: 连接你的设计系统
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: The zeroheight MCP connects ChatGPT directly to your design system documentation. Give your AI assistant access to your styleguide — components, tokens, patterns, and usage rules — so it can reference the right guidelines while generating code or answering questions about your design system.
payload.longDescription: zeroheight MCP 可将 ChatGPT 直接连接到你的设计系统文档。让 AI 助手访问样式指南中的组件、设计令牌、模式和使用规则，以便在生成代码或回答设计系统相关问题时遵循正确规范。

payload.name: AI Task Brief Builder
payload.description: 构建有证据依据的任务说明
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Turn supplied development materials into evidence-based task goals, test requirements, and implementation briefs. The plugin separates confirmed requirements from unconfirmed suggestions, keeps scope and constraints clear, and identifies missing information without inventing requirements.
payload.longDescription: 将提供的开发材料转换为有证据依据的任务目标、测试要求和实施说明。插件区分已确认要求与未确认建议，明确范围和约束，并识别缺失信息，不会凭空编造要求。

payload.name: Stele
payload.description: 在 AI 智能体间共享记忆
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Stele gives AI agents a shared, persistent knowledge graph and task system for your projects. Capture decisions, architecture, lessons, and work once, then make that context available across ChatGPT, Codex, Claude, Cursor, and other MCP-compatible agents. Agents can find prior context, maintain project knowledge, and coordinate work without starting from scratch.
payload.longDescription: Stele 为 AI 智能体提供共享、持久的知识图谱和项目任务系统。只需记录一次决策、架构、经验和工作内容，即可让 ChatGPT、Codex、Claude、Cursor 及其他兼容 MCP 的智能体共享这些背景。智能体能够查找先前背景、维护项目知识并协调工作，无需从头开始。

payload.name: Opscotch
payload.description: 知识与验证
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Opscotch MCP Server gives AI assistants direct access to Opscotch knowledge and authoring tools.

The MCP server exposes structured tools that allow AI assistants to understand, author, validate, and work with Opscotch applications and workflows.

The server is designed for developers using AI coding assistants, and automation engineers who want to build or maintain Opscotch solutions using natural language.

An AI connected to the server can perform tasks such as:
- answer questions about the Opscotch platform
- explain APIs, configuration, and runtime behaviour
- author workflows and bootstrap configurations
- validate workflow structure and configuration
- assist with packaging, deployment, and licensing
- provide guidance using the latest platform capabilities
- generate examples and implementation patterns

With MCP, the AI can use purpose-built tools that understand the Opscotch platform, resulting in responses that are:

- more accurate
- aware of current platform features
- capable of structured authoring rather than just producing text
- less prone to hallucinating APIs or configuration

Typical use cases
- "Create a workflow that polls an HTTP endpoint every minute."
- "Why won't this bootstrap validate?"
- "Generate a workflow that receives webhooks and forwards them to AWS SQS."
- "Explain this JavaScript processor."
- "Help migrate this workflow to the latest Opscotch version."
- "Help me generate a signed package for deployment."

The server is intended for:

- AI coding assistants
- IDE integrations
- CLI agents
- automation developers
- DevOps and platform engineers
- custom AI applications that need authoritative knowledge of Opscotch
payload.longDescription:
Opscotch MCP Server 为 AI 助手提供直接访问 Opscotch 知识和创作工具的能力。

该 MCP 服务器提供结构化工具，帮助 AI 助手理解、创作、验证并处理 Opscotch 应用和工作流。

此服务器面向使用 AI 编程助手的开发者，以及希望用自然语言构建或维护 Opscotch 解决方案的自动化工程师。

连接该服务器的 AI 可以执行以下任务：
- 回答有关 Opscotch 平台的问题
- 解释 API、配置和运行时行为
- 编写工作流和引导配置
- 验证工作流结构与配置
- 协助打包、部署和许可
- 根据平台最新功能提供指导
- 生成示例和实现模式

通过 MCP，AI 可以使用专为理解 Opscotch 平台而打造的工具，从而让回答：

- 更准确
- 了解当前的平台功能
- 能够进行结构化创作，而不只是生成文本
- 更不容易虚构 API 或配置

典型使用场景
- “创建一个每分钟轮询 HTTP 端点的工作流。”
- “为什么这个引导配置无法通过验证？”
- “生成一个接收 webhook 并转发到 AWS SQS 的工作流。”
- “解释这个 JavaScript 处理器。”
- “帮助我将此工作流迁移到最新版本的 Opscotch。”
- “帮我生成用于部署的签名包。”

该服务器面向：

- AI 编程助手
- IDE 集成
- CLI 智能体
- 自动化开发者
- DevOps 和平台工程师
- 需要 Opscotch 权威知识的定制 AI 应用

payload.name: MGS Agile Toolkit
payload.description: 敏捷教练指导与工具
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Access to expert, 24x7 Scrum and agile coaching, expert level user story splitting, product backlog item generation and access to your Mountain Goat Software video course library, right inside ChatGPT.

This is the only set of tools about user stories that are designed by author of the popular User Stories Applied book, Mike Cohn.
payload.longDescription:
直接在 ChatGPT 中获得专家提供的 24x7 Scrum 和敏捷教练指导、专家级用户故事拆分、产品待办事项生成，以及 Mountain Goat Software 视频课程库访问权限。

这是唯一一套由畅销书《User Stories Applied》的作者 Mike Cohn 设计的用户故事工具。

payload.name: ConsentLayer
payload.description: 管理 Cookie 同意设置
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ConsentLayer helps website owners set up and manage GDPR, CCPA, and LGPD cookie consent through ChatGPT. It can provision a site, scan for tracking technologies, configure consent categories and banner behavior, generate installation snippets, verify a live installation, and manage ongoing compliance workflows such as scanner reviews, geolocation rules, cookie policies, and Do Not Sell requests.
payload.longDescription: ConsentLayer 帮助网站所有者通过 ChatGPT 设置和管理符合 GDPR、CCPA 和 LGPD 要求的 Cookie 同意机制。它可以配置网站、扫描跟踪技术、设置同意类别和横幅行为、生成安装代码片段、验证线上安装情况，并管理持续合规工作流，例如扫描器审核、地理位置规则、Cookie 政策和 Do Not Sell 请求。

payload.name: API Impact Mapper
payload.description: 映射 API 变更和影响
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Extract explicit API changes, classify breaking changes, and map evidence-based impacts across consumers, tests, and documentation. Uses only the facts supplied by the user and does not access external systems.
payload.longDescription: 提取明确的 API 变更、对破坏性变更分类，并映射对使用方、测试和文档的有证据依据的影响。仅使用用户提供的事实，不访问外部系统。

payload.name: zyberspace
payload.description: 在 ChatGPT 中创建网站
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
ZyberSpace lets you create and publish professional business websites in minutes. Describe your business, choose your style, and ZyberSpace turns it into a live, mobile and agent-ready website.

Go beyond basic online presence. With ZyberSpace, local businesses can launch service pages, landing pages, lead-generation sites, portfolios, restaurant pages, salon websites, contractor websites, and small business websites designed to attract customers.

Built-in website features include:

- AI-generated website copy and layouts
- Hosting and public website links
- Mobile-friendly pages
- Contact and quote request forms
- SEO-ready business pages
- Custom domains
- SSL-secured websites
- Template marketplace for local business categories
- Easy editing and republishing

Launch and improve with confidence. ZyberSpace helps businesses quickly update content, refine pages, publish changes, and keep their website looking professional without needing a designer or developer.

Zero setup required. No coding, no hosting configuration, no complicated tools, and no technical setup. Just describe your business, customize your site, and publish.
payload.longDescription:
ZyberSpace 让你在几分钟内创建并发布专业的商业网站。描述你的业务，选择风格，ZyberSpace 就会将其变成适配移动设备、可供智能体使用的线上网站。

不仅仅是基础网络形象。借助 ZyberSpace，本地商家可以创建服务页面、落地页、获客网站、作品集、餐厅页面、美发沙龙网站、承包商网站以及吸引客户的小型企业网站。

内置网站功能包括：

- AI 生成的网站文案和布局
- 托管服务和公开网站链接
- 适配移动设备的页面
- 联系和报价申请表单
- 面向 SEO 优化的商业页面
- 自定义域名
- SSL 安全网站
- 面向本地商业类别的模板市场
- 轻松编辑并重新发布

放心上线并持续改进。ZyberSpace 帮助企业快速更新内容、优化页面、发布更改，并保持网站专业形象，无需设计师或开发人员。

无需任何设置。不用编写代码、配置托管服务、使用复杂工具或进行技术设置。只需描述业务、自定义网站并发布即可。

payload.name: DocRunic
payload.description: 搜索、阅读和管理文档
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect DocRunic to ChatGPT to work with documentation in your authorized workspaces. Search and browse pages, read current content and version history, inspect page structures and attachment metadata, create or update drafts, and publish documentation when requested.

Access is protected by DocRunic OAuth and follows the workspace access, role, and scopes granted to the connection. The plugin does not expose tools for deleting or archiving pages.
payload.longDescription:
将 DocRunic 连接到 ChatGPT，即可在获授权的工作区中处理文档。搜索和浏览页面，阅读当前内容和版本历史，检查页面结构和附件元数据，创建或更新草稿，并按需发布文档。

访问受 DocRunic OAuth 保护，并遵循该连接获授的工作区访问权限、角色和范围。此插件不提供删除或归档页面的工具。

payload.name: IDrive e2
payload.description: 管理 IDrive e2 存储
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your IDrive e2 account to browse regions, manage buckets and objects, configure lifecycle and Object Lock settings, and generate presigned links using natural-language prompts.
payload.longDescription: 关联 IDrive e2 账户后，可使用自然语言提示浏览区域、管理存储桶和对象、配置生命周期与 Object Lock 设置，以及生成预签名链接。

payload.name: Camber
payload.description: 构建并运行数据智能体
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Camber lets users manage accounts and workspaces, discover or create agents, and launch and monitor agent runs directly within ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Camber 让用户可以直接在 ChatGPT 中管理账户和工作空间、发现或创建智能体，并启动和监控智能体运行。

payload.name: NPMScan
payload.description: npm 软件包与漏洞查询
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Look up npm package metadata, known vulnerabilities, and CVE details directly from a conversation. NPMScan's MCP server gives AI agents read-only tools backed by the npm registry, OSV.dev, GitHub Security Advisories, GitHub's own API, and the NIST National Vulnerability Database: search packages by name or keyword with download counts, dependent-package counts, and typosquat detection on every result; inspect a package's install scripts, maintainers, license, GitHub stars, and download trend before installing, or compare 2-5 candidates side-by-side with a deterministic pick; check an exact version pinned in a lockfile, or simulate upgrading one before running npm install to see if it's a safe patch or a likely-breaking major bump; query vulnerabilities for one package or up to 100 at once, each finding enriched with severity, a summary, CVE aliases, and the fixed version rather than a bare advisory ID; audit an entire GitHub repository's dependencies (including monorepo workspaces) in one call, or generate a spec-valid CycloneDX/SPDX SBOM with vulnerability and license data embedded; rank the findings from a raw `npm audit --json` report by CISA KEV/FIRST EPSS exploitation data to know what to fix first, then pull the concrete, ordered remediation playbook for a flagged finding; check an npm maintainer account's publish history for a compromised-account-style cluster, or pull their basic profile; browse the latest npm advisories from either GitHub's curated, mostly CVE-backed reviewed set or its known-malicious-package malware feed, filterable by severity, vulnerability category (XSS, SQL/NoSQL Injection, SSRF, Access Control, Code Injection, and 15 more, reviewed only), affected package, or an exact GHSA/CVE ID; and look up authoritative CVSS/CWE data for any CVE across any ecosystem, enriched with CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities status and FIRST.org's EPSS exploitation-probability score. No API key or authentication is required, and every result links back to the full write-up on npmscan.com.
payload.longDescription: 直接在对话中查询 npm 软件包元数据、已知漏洞和 CVE 详情。NPMScan 的 MCP 服务器提供只读工具，数据来自 npm 注册表、OSV.dev、GitHub Security Advisories、GitHub 自身 API 和 NIST 国家漏洞数据库：按名称或关键词搜索软件包，并在每条结果中提供下载量、依赖该包的软件包数量和拼写仿冒检测；安装前检查软件包的安装脚本、维护者、许可证、GitHub 星标和下载趋势，或并排比较 2-5 个候选项并给出确定性选择；检查锁文件中固定的精确版本，或模拟升级版本，以便在运行 npm install 前判断是安全补丁还是可能造成破坏的主版本升级；一次查询一个软件包或最多 100 个软件包的漏洞，每项发现均附严重程度、摘要、CVE 别名和修复版本，而非只有公告编号；一次审计整个 GitHub 仓库的依赖（包括 monorepo 工作区），或生成符合规范的 CycloneDX/SPDX SBOM，并嵌入漏洞和许可证数据；根据 CISA KEV/FIRST EPSS 利用数据对原始 `npm audit --json` 报告中的发现排序，判断应优先修复哪些问题，然后获取针对已标记问题的具体、有序修复方案；检查 npm 维护者账户的发布历史，查找疑似账户被盗后的异常发布集群，或查看其基本资料；浏览最新 npm 公告，包括 GitHub 精选且主要基于 CVE、经过审核的公告，以及已知恶意软件包信息流，并可按严重程度、漏洞类别（XSS、SQL/NoSQL 注入、SSRF、访问控制、代码注入等 15 种以上，仅限已审核类别）、受影响软件包或精确 GHSA/CVE ID 筛选；查询任何生态系统中任意 CVE 的权威 CVSS/CWE 数据，并补充 CISA 已知遭利用漏洞状态和 FIRST.org EPSS 利用概率评分。无需 API 密钥或身份验证，每条结果都会链接到 npmscan.com 上的完整说明。

payload.name: BasicDeploy
payload.description: 在聊天中部署应用
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
BasicDeploy lets your assistant create a live container for a web app, deploy code to it, and manage it — all from the chat. Each app comes with a PostgreSQL database, S3-compatible object storage, environment variables, and a public HTTPS URL, set up automatically.

Through the connector, the assistant can create containers, deploy a project, run shell commands, and read logs. You can also add hosted sign-up and login to the apps you build over standard OpenID Connect, so your app gets its own users without writing an auth system. You sign in once with your BasicDeploy account — no API key to paste. Pricing is a flat monthly rate that includes the database, storage, bandwidth, and URL.
payload.longDescription:
BasicDeploy 让助手在聊天中为 Web 应用创建在线容器、部署代码并管理应用。每个应用都自动配备 PostgreSQL 数据库、兼容 S3 的对象存储、环境变量和公开 HTTPS URL。

通过连接器，助手可以创建容器、部署项目、运行 shell 命令和读取日志。你还可以通过标准 OpenID Connect 为所构建的应用添加托管的注册和登录功能，让应用拥有自己的用户，无需编写认证系统。使用 BasicDeploy 账户登录一次即可，无需粘贴 API 密钥。定价为固定月费，包含数据库、存储、带宽和 URL。

payload.name: PR Readiness Check
payload.description: 检查 PR 的评审就绪情况
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Analyzes supplied pull request materials for change evidence, requirement alignment, testing, risks, rollback, and readiness for human review. It does not access repositories, run tests, approve, or merge pull requests.
payload.longDescription: 分析提供的拉取请求材料，检查变更证据、需求匹配度、测试、风险、回滚方案，以及是否已准备好交由人工评审。它不会访问代码仓库、运行测试、批准或合并拉取请求。

payload.name: Prism by Crossdeck
payload.description: 应用商业智能分析
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Prism reads your live Crossdeck workspace — revenue, entitlements, errors, analytics, read-cost and customer identity — joined BY IDENTITY, so it answers cross-layer questions no single-layer tool can: which paying customers an error hit and what they pay, who costs the most in database reads, and your lifetime-value leaderboard by name. Secure and read-only: OAuth 2.0 sign-in (no key to paste), no write path, and every number is self-describing (it reports 'not instrumented' rather than a fake zero for an un-wired surface).
payload.longDescription: Prism 可读取你实时的 Crossdeck 工作区——包括收入、权限、错误、分析数据、读取成本和客户身份——并按身份关联数据，因此能回答任何单层工具都无法回答的跨层问题：哪些付费客户遇到了某个错误以及他们支付了多少费用、哪些客户产生了最高的数据库读取成本，以及按姓名排列的客户生命周期价值排行榜。安全且只读：通过 OAuth 2.0 登录（无需粘贴密钥），没有写入功能；每个数字都附带自我说明（对于未接入的功能会报告“未埋点”，而不是伪造零值）。

payload.name: mittwald
payload.description: 管理 mittwald 托管服务
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Manage your mittwald (mStudio) hosting infrastructure from ChatGPT. List and inspect projects, apps, servers and domains; provision and manage MySQL and Redis databases, users, backups and backup schedules; work with containers, stacks, cron jobs and volumes; configure domains, DNS zones, virtual hosts, SSL certificates and mail addresses; manage organization and project members, SSH users and keys, and API tokens. Read-only tools inspect resources, while write tools create, update or remove them on the authenticated user's behalf.
payload.longDescription: 通过 ChatGPT 管理你的 mittwald（mStudio）托管基础设施。列出并检查项目、应用、服务器和域名；配置和管理 MySQL 与 Redis 数据库、用户、备份及备份计划；管理容器、技术栈、cron 作业和卷；配置域名、DNS 区域、虚拟主机、SSL 证书和邮件地址；管理组织和项目成员、SSH 用户和密钥，以及 API 令牌。只读工具用于检查资源，写入工具则会代表已验证身份的用户创建、更新或删除资源。

payload.name: Flyte
payload.description: 编写、迁移、运行和调试
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Author, run, and deploy Flyte 2 workflows, apps, and agents with skills grounded in the Flyte SDK and documentation. In ChatGPT web, search Flyte docs and SDK examples. In a local ChatGPT environment with the Flyte CLI configured, run and manage your authenticated Flyte cluster.
payload.longDescription: 基于 Flyte SDK 和文档中的技能，编写、运行和部署 Flyte 2 工作流、应用和代理。在 ChatGPT 网页版中搜索 Flyte 文档和 SDK 示例。在已配置 Flyte CLI 的本地 ChatGPT 环境中，运行并管理经过身份验证的 Flyte 集群。

payload.name: Lumen UI
payload.description: 使用 Lumen 构建界面
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Lumen UI helps coding agents build accessible interfaces from a real multi-framework design-system contract. Search the component catalog, retrieve framework-specific usage and source, inspect web and native recipes, read semantic tokens, and follow the bundled Lumen workflow for Astro, React, Web Components, React Native, SwiftUI, and Jetpack Compose.
payload.longDescription: Lumen UI 帮助编程智能体依据实际的多框架设计系统规范，构建无障碍界面。搜索组件目录，获取特定框架的用法和源代码，查看 Web 与原生应用的实现示例，读取语义化设计变量，并遵循随附的 Lumen 工作流，适用于 Astro、React、Web Components、React Native、SwiftUI 和 Jetpack Compose。

payload.name: Resolve AI
payload.description: 生产环境 AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect ChatGPT and Codex to Resolve AI. Start and steer investigations, pull live production context, and turn root-cause findings into pull requests.
The Resolve plugin connects ChatGPT and Codex to Resolve AI over MCP. Resolve's agents join your on-call rotations to triage and investigate alerts and work alongside engineers to reach root cause faster; this plugin brings that surface directly into your coding agent so you can act on it where you already code.
It installs skills for listing and filtering alerts, reading and summarizing investigations, starting new root-cause analyses, asking follow-up questions, steering an active investigation with context you have locally, pulling an area's production profile before a risky change, and translating findings into local code changes and a PR.
payload.longDescription:
该插件生产环境 AI。以下功能和限制适用：
Connect ChatGPT and Codex to Resolve AI. Start and steer investigations, pull live production context, and turn root-cause findings into pull requests.
The Resolve plugin connects ChatGPT and Codex to Resolve AI over MCP. Resolve's agents join your on-call rotations to triage and investigate alerts and work alongside engineers to reach root cause faster; this plugin brings that surface directly into your coding agent so you can act on it where you already code.
It installs skills for listing and filtering alerts, reading and summarizing investigations, starting new root-cause analyses, asking follow-up questions, steering an active investigation with context you have locally, pulling an area's production profile before a risky change, and translating findings into local code changes and a PR.

payload.name: HTML/CSS to Image API
payload.description: HTML 转图片及网址截图
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The HTML/CSS to Image MCP server lets AI assistants create production-ready images, website screenshots, and PDFs through natural-language instructions.

Use it to:

- Render HTML and CSS into PNG, JPG, WebP, or PDF
- Capture screenshots of public URLs
- Generate images from reusable templates and variables
- Create batches of multiple image variations
- Create, update, list, and version image templates
- Configure viewport size, device scale, selectors, render delays, and other rendering options
payload.longDescription:
HTML/CSS to Image MCP 服务器让 AI 助手通过自然语言指令创建可用于生产环境的图像、网站截图和 PDF。

可用于：

- 将 HTML 和 CSS 渲染为 PNG、JPG、WebP 或 PDF
- 截取公开网址的屏幕截图
- 使用可复用模板和变量生成图像
- 批量创建多个图像变体
- 创建、更新、列出图像模板并管理其版本
- 配置视口尺寸、设备缩放比例、选择器、渲染延迟及其他渲染选项

payload.name: HOME AI Node
payload.description: 节点健康状况与任务状态
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: HOME AI Node lets ChatGPT inspect the health, runtime state, and tracked tasks of a HOME AI node. get_node_status reports whether a node is online and its repository state, get_runtime_state shows the runtime mode and MCP protocol, and get_task_status queries task progress. In this phase the server is backed by a deterministic synthetic review fixture (node review-demo-node) so reviewers can exercise every tool without any private network access; connection to a real HOME AI node is a later phase behind an authorized-user boundary (OAuth). All operations are strictly read-only: nothing on this server can write, execute, or reach any private network.
payload.longDescription: HOME AI Node 可让 ChatGPT 检查 HOME AI 节点的健康状况、运行状态和跟踪任务。get_node_status 会报告节点是否在线及其仓库状态；get_runtime_state 会显示运行模式和 MCP 协议；get_task_status 会查询任务进度。在此阶段，服务器使用确定性的合成审查样例（节点 review-demo-node），供审查者在不访问任何专用网络的情况下测试所有工具。连接真实 HOME AI 节点属于后续阶段，并须通过授权用户边界（OAuth）。所有操作都严格只读：此服务器不能写入、执行操作或访问任何专用网络。

payload.name: Knock
payload.description: 跨渠道向用户发送消息
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Knock is agent-first customer engagement infrastructure for your product, marketing, and transactional messaging. One platform to manage all your messaging across email, SMS, push, chat, and in-app.

Inspect workflows and manage notifications, directly in ChatGPT and Codex.
payload.longDescription:
Knock 是面向代理优先的产品、营销和事务性消息客户互动基础设施。通过一个平台管理电子邮件、短信、推送、聊天和应用内消息。

直接在 ChatGPT 和 Codex 中检查工作流并管理通知。

payload.name: Suger
payload.description: 管理云 GTM 数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Suger helps marketplace teams work with cloud marketplace, CRM, co-sell, integration, billing, and knowledge data in ChatGPT. Users can look up offers, buyers, entitlements, referrals, integrations, workflow runs, CRM records, and support knowledge, and perform enabled actions through their connected Suger organization.
payload.longDescription: Suger 帮助市场团队在 ChatGPT 中处理云市场、CRM、联合销售、集成、账单和知识数据。用户可以查询优惠、买家、授权权益、推荐、集成、工作流运行记录、CRM 记录和支持知识，并通过已连接的 Suger 组织执行已启用的操作。

payload.name: Uizze
payload.description: 打造出众的 UI 设计
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Uizze gives coding agents a free anti-ui-slop Skill and optional full MCP access to live UI references, license-clear materials, and rendered safety checks. Use the skill to inspect the product and design system, write a design contract, cover required states, and run a bounded finish gate. The MCP answers one concrete unresolved UI question with strong full-screen references, finds license-clear materials for a concrete role, or optionally checks rendered UI for observable breakage, accessibility, privacy, and task-blocking composition. The free preview MCP exposes a deterministic source check only.
payload.longDescription: Uizze 为编程智能体提供免费的反 UI 套模板 Skill，并可选完整 MCP 访问权限，以查看实时 UI 参考、许可清晰的素材和渲染后的安全检查结果。使用该 Skill 检查产品和设计系统、编写设计约定、覆盖必需状态，并运行范围明确的收尾检查。MCP 可以针对一个具体且尚未解决的 UI 问题提供有力的全屏参考，为具体角色查找许可清晰的素材，或按需检查渲染后的 UI 是否存在可观察到的故障、无障碍问题、隐私问题以及妨碍任务完成的布局。免费预览版 MCP 仅提供确定性的源代码检查。

payload.name: TALON Knowledge
payload.description: 搜索 TALON 手册和问答
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
A connector that lets AI agents search the official knowledge base of TALON, a low-code platform for building business applications. It searches thousands of pages of official manuals, support Q&A, a database of 900+ real-world function configuration examples, and specification analyses, and returns answers with source URLs as evidence. Typical uses include feature design consultation, configuration value lookups, error-cause investigation, browsing similar real-world examples, and automated validation of generated settings.

A TALON maintenance contract and a TALON support site (Zendesk) account are required. Users authenticate by signing in to the support site when connecting. All tools are read-only, and users' conversation content, code, and attachments are never sent to our servers (details: https://mcp.talon.jp/privacy).
payload.longDescription:
此连接器可让 AI 智能体搜索 TALON 的官方知识库。TALON 是一个用于构建业务应用的低代码平台。它会搜索数千页官方手册、支持问答、包含 900+ 个真实功能配置示例的数据库以及规范分析，并返回带来源 URL 的答案作为依据。典型用途包括功能设计咨询、查询配置值、调查错误原因、浏览相似真实案例，以及自动验证生成的设置。

需要 TALON 维护合同和 TALON 支持网站（Zendesk）账户。连接时，用户需登录支持网站完成身份验证。所有工具均为只读，用户的对话内容、代码和附件绝不会发送到我们的服务器（详情：https://mcp.talon.jp/privacy）。

payload.name: Craftian
payload.description: 创建完整可用的 Web 应用
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create fully working business software and web apps from a prompt. With Craftian you can create CRMs, task managers, inventory systems, expense trackers, time trackers, job portals, on-boarding portals, data forms etc.

Craftian creates production-ready web apps with built-in database, authentication, role-based access control, file storage, and automatic cloud deployment.

No coding experience required. Just describe what you want, and keep refining it.
payload.longDescription:
根据提示创建完整可用的商业软件和 Web 应用。使用 Craftian，您可以创建 CRM、任务管理器、库存系统、费用跟踪器、时间跟踪器、招聘门户、入职门户、数据表单等。

Craftian 创建可用于生产环境的 Web 应用，内置数据库、身份验证、基于角色的访问控制、文件存储和自动云部署。

无需编码经验。只需描述想要的内容，并持续完善。

payload.name: FluxBuilder
payload.description: 创建电商应用
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect to the FluxBuilder MCP server to manage native Flutter app projects for WooCommerce, Shopify, and WordPress. Easily create apps, redesign screens, update settings, search store catalogs, capture mobile previews, and run test or release builds for the App Store, Google Play, and web—all without writing code.
payload.longDescription: 连接 FluxBuilder MCP 服务器，以管理 WooCommerce、Shopify 和 WordPress 的原生 Flutter 应用项目。无需编写代码，即可轻松创建应用、重新设计屏幕、更新设置、搜索商店目录、捕获移动端预览，并为 App Store、Google Play 和 Web 运行测试版或发布版构建。

payload.name: Sleuth Skills
payload.description: 在聊天中使用自定义技能
payload.summaryOriginal: Use your custom skills in chat
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Sleuth Skills connects ChatGPT to your personal skills.new vault — a private collection of skills, rules, agents, and slash commands you've authored or saved. The app lets ChatGPT discover what's in your vault and load the full content of a specific skill on demand, so conversations can follow your own playbooks instead of relying on generic knowledge. It is read-only: it never modifies, deletes, or shares your vault content.
payload.longDescription: Sleuth Skills 将 ChatGPT 连接到你的个人 skills.new 知识库——其中私密收藏着你创建或保存的技能、规则、智能体和斜杠命令。该应用可让 ChatGPT 发现知识库中的内容，并按需加载特定技能的完整内容，让对话遵循你自己的工作方法，而不是依赖通用知识。它是只读的：绝不会修改、删除或分享你的知识库内容。

payload.name: Dependency Upgrade Plan
payload.description: 规划依赖项升级
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Creates evidence-based dependency upgrade preparation plans from supplied release, usage, testing, and rollback materials. It does not modify repositories, execute upgrades, run tests, commit changes, or create pull requests.
payload.longDescription: 根据提供的版本发布、使用、测试和回滚材料，制定有依据的依赖项升级准备计划。它不会修改代码仓库、执行升级、运行测试、提交更改或创建拉取请求。

payload.name: EzzyBills
payload.description: 使用 EzzyBills API 构建应用
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Access the authoritative EzzyBills developer specification, REST API contracts, authentication models, and integration guidance for building EzzyBills applications such as approval dashboards, email response workflows, and purchase order tools.
payload.longDescription: 获取权威的 EzzyBills 开发者规范、REST API 合约、身份验证模型和集成指南，用于构建 EzzyBills 应用，例如审批仪表板、邮件回复工作流和采购订单工具。

payload.name: Control Plane
payload.description: 部署和运行云应用
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Control Plane runs containerized apps across AWS, GCP, Azure, Oracle Cloud, and your own hardware as one platform. Build a GitHub or a GitLab repo into a container and deploy it to a live HTTPS URL, give it a custom domain, attach Postgres or Redis, and let it autoscale. Diagnose failures from logs, metrics, and events, and find the over-provisioned workloads inflating your cloud bill.
payload.longDescription: Control Plane 可在 AWS、GCP、Azure、Oracle Cloud 和自有硬件上，将容器化应用作为一个平台运行。将 GitHub 或 GitLab 仓库构建为容器并部署到可公开访问的 HTTPS URL，配置自定义域名、连接 Postgres 或 Redis，并启用自动扩缩容。还可根据日志、指标和事件诊断故障，并找出推高云账单的过度配置工作负载。

payload.name: Birdie
payload.description: 捕捉客户问题的上下文
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Birdie helps you capture customer issues and turn them into clear context for troubleshooting.

Instead of relying on written descriptions, customers can record their screen to show the issue. Birdie captures the full context, including what happened, what they clicked, and technical evidence such as console logs, network requests, session data, device metadata, and reproduction steps.

This gives your agent the context it needs to understand the issue, troubleshoot it accurately, and move faster to a resolution.

With Birdie, your agent does not have to guess what the customer meant. It can see what the customer saw and use the right evidence to investigate the issue.

Built for support and technical teams, Birdie reduces back and forth and helps both humans and AI troubleshoot customer issues faster.
payload.longDescription:
Birdie 帮助你捕捉客户问题，并转化为清晰的故障排查上下文。

客户可以录制屏幕展示问题，无需只依赖文字描述。Birdie 捕捉完整上下文，包括发生了什么、点击了什么，以及控制台日志、网络请求、会话数据、设备元数据和复现步骤等技术证据。

这些信息为智能体提供理解问题、准确排查并更快解决问题所需的上下文。

使用 Birdie，智能体无需猜测客户的意思。它可以看到客户所看到的内容，并用合适的证据调查问题。

Birdie 专为支持和技术团队打造，减少反复沟通，帮助人类和 AI 更快排查客户问题。

payload.name: Test Failure Triage
payload.description: 分诊测试失败
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Turn supplied test output into a clear failure list, evidence-based classifications, and an investigation order. The plugin works only from the information you provide and does not access code, CI systems, repositories, or external services.
payload.longDescription: 将提供的测试输出整理成清晰的失败清单、基于证据的分类和调查顺序。此插件仅依据你提供的信息工作，不会访问代码、CI 系统、代码库或外部服务。

payload.name: BitsWeave
payload.description: 你的工具与上下文
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Bitsweave is a user-owned context layer for AI tools. It stores the structured work of your organization, connects it via a context graph and exposes it to Claude over MCP.

Sign in with OAuth. ChatGPT can search and hydrate your org context so you do not repeat who you are, what the project is, or what you already decided.

What you can do:
• Look up a specific fact about your company, a past decision, or a current task.
• Ask a synthesis question across decisions, notes, and related records.
• Create or update a Bitsweave record from the conversation when you want the result stored.

Connect GitHub, email, and other tools through Bitsweave brokers when you enable them. Claude calls Bitsweave. Bitsweave uses the permissions you granted. The agent does not hold the upstream credentials.

Sign-in is required. The connector URL is https://bitsweave.com/api/mcp.

Setup: add Bitsweave, complete the OAuth sign-in, then ask ChatGPT to search your context or create a record. Public docs: https://bitsweave.com/docs/use/onboarding/connect-your-agents
payload.longDescription:
Bitsweave 是由用户拥有的 AI 工具上下文层。它存储组织的结构化工作内容，通过上下文图谱关联这些内容，并通过 MCP 向 Claude 提供访问。

使用 OAuth 登录。ChatGPT 可以搜索并加载你的组织上下文，让你不必重复说明自己的身份、项目内容或已经做出的决定。

你可以：
• 查询关于公司、过去决定或当前任务的具体事实。
• 跨决定、笔记和相关记录提出综合性问题。
• 希望保存结果时，根据对话创建或更新 Bitsweave 记录。

启用后，通过 Bitsweave 代理连接 GitHub、电子邮件及其他工具。Claude 调用 Bitsweave，Bitsweave 使用你授予的权限。智能体不持有上游服务的凭据。

需要登录。连接器 URL 为 https://bitsweave.com/api/mcp。

设置：添加 Bitsweave，完成 OAuth 登录，然后让 ChatGPT 搜索你的上下文或创建记录。公开文档：https://bitsweave.com/docs/use/onboarding/connect-your-agents

payload.name: Prefect
payload.description: 检查 Prefect 工作流
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect Prefect Cloud to inspect workflows, diagnose failed, late, or stuck runs, review workspace and worker health, and search current Prefect documentation and release notes. The hosted tools are read-only.
payload.longDescription: 连接 Prefect Cloud，检查工作流、诊断失败、延迟或卡住的运行，查看工作区和工作进程的健康状况，并搜索最新的 Prefect 文档和发行说明。托管工具均为只读。

payload.name: Vynix
payload.description: 处理网站反馈
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Vynix MCP brings visual website feedback into ChatGPT so teams can fix issues with full context instead of guesswork. It lets ChatGPT access projects, annotations, comments, screenshots, and AI diagnosis data, then help you prioritize, investigate, and resolve work quickly. Teams can update annotation status, add comments, create GitHub issues, and generate share links from one workflow.

Built for product, engineering, and QA teams, Vynix MCP reduces back-and-forth by connecting discussion and implementation in one place.
payload.longDescription:
Vynix MCP 将网站视觉反馈引入 ChatGPT，让团队能够基于完整上下文排查问题，而不必猜测。它让 ChatGPT 访问项目、标注、评论、截图和 AI 诊断数据，进而帮助你快速安排优先级、调查并解决问题。团队可以在一个工作流中更新标注状态、添加评论、创建 GitHub 问题并生成分享链接。

Vynix MCP 专为产品、工程和 QA 团队打造，通过将讨论与实施衔接起来，减少来回沟通。

payload.name: NeuronSearchLab
payload.description: 管理推荐系统
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Inspect and manage your NeuronSearchLab recommendation workspace from ChatGPT. Search catalogue items, understand rankings, configure contexts, pipelines, rules and segments, run experiments and model training, and review performance analytics.
payload.longDescription: 在 ChatGPT 中查看并管理你的 NeuronSearchLab 推荐工作区。搜索目录条目、了解排名、配置上下文、流水线、规则和细分群体、运行实验和模型训练，并查看效果分析。

payload.name: Extend
payload.description: 将文档转化为数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Parse, extract, classify, and split documents from chat: pull fields, tables, and line items out of PDFs, images, Office files, and spreadsheets, identify document types, break bundles into separate documents, and fill PDF forms. Build and test reusable extractors, classifiers, and workflows on real documents, then run them at scale in your Extend workspace.
payload.longDescription: 在聊天中解析、提取、分类和拆分文档：从 PDF、图像、Office 文件和电子表格中提取字段、表格和明细项，识别文档类型，将文件包拆分为独立文档，并填写 PDF 表单。在真实文档上构建并测试可复用的提取器、分类器和工作流，然后在 Extend 工作区中大规模运行。

payload.name: Relewise Developer
payload.description: 构建 Relewise 集成
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Build, review, and troubleshoot Relewise Search, Recommendations, behavioral tracking, and data integrations with current API and SDK guidance for C#, TypeScript/JavaScript, PHP, and Java.
payload.longDescription: 根据适用于 C#、TypeScript/JavaScript、PHP 和 Java 的最新 API 与 SDK 指南，构建、审查并排查 Relewise 搜索、推荐、行为跟踪和数据集成问题。

payload.name: MCP Conduct Register
payload.description: 检查 MCP 服务器行为
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
This plugin exposes a public register of measured conduct for MCP servers.

Five conditions are measured on a schedule: the server speaks MCP, it publishes an A2A agent card, it declares who pays it, identical input returns identical output, and the verdict itself can be recomputed by a third party. A condition that could not be measured is recorded as not measured. It is never counted as a pass, and that rule is not relaxed for the operator of the register.

The register does not rank servers. It does not recommend one server over another. It returns what was measured, when it was measured, and the SHA-256 of the record so that the reading can be checked by someone who does not trust the party that issued it.

An endpoint that is absent from the register has simply never been measured here. Absence is reported as absence and is not a negative verdict.

Determinism is not measured unless the owner of the checked server has recorded consent, because measuring it requires executing a tool on someone else's server.

Free, read only, no account and no key. The register is a build artefact of a scheduled script with no editorial step, and it is archived with a DOI so a citation survives the repository moving.
payload.longDescription:
此插件展示 MCP 服务器已测量行为的公开登记信息。

系统会按计划测量五项条件：服务器是否使用 MCP、是否发布 A2A 智能体卡、是否声明由谁付费、相同输入是否返回相同输出，以及第三方能否重新计算判断结果。无法测量的条件会记录为“未测量”，绝不会计为通过，登记方运营者也不能放宽此规则。

登记册不会对服务器排名，也不会推荐某台服务器优于另一台。它会返回已测量的内容、测量时间和记录的 SHA-256 值，让不信任发布方的人也能自行核验。

未出现在登记册中的端点，只表示从未在此处测量。缺失会如实报告为缺失，不代表负面判断。

除非被检查服务器的所有者已记录同意，否则不会测量确定性，因为这需要在他人的服务器上执行工具。

免费、只读、无需账户或密钥。登记册是由定时脚本生成的构建产物，不经过编辑环节，并以 DOI 归档，确保即使代码仓库迁移，引用仍然有效。

payload.name: Kody
payload.description: 将智能体的工作转化为软件
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Kody turns successful work in ChatGPT into durable, user-owned software. ChatGPT can use Kody to find the user's available capabilities and turn working solutions into reusable packages, schedules, webhooks, portable memories, and secret-backed connections. Credentials remain server-side, installed community packages are forked into the user's account, and saved workflows can run later without another model call. The same user-owned artifacts remain available across MCP-capable agents.
payload.longDescription: Kody 可将你在 ChatGPT 中取得的成果转化为持久、由你拥有的软件。ChatGPT 可以借助 Kody 查找你可用的能力，并将有效方案转化为可重复使用的软件包、计划、webhook、可移植记忆以及由密钥支持的连接。凭据保留在服务器端；安装的社区软件包会分叉到你的账户中；保存的工作流日后运行时无需再次调用模型。同一批由用户拥有的成果也可供支持 MCP 的智能体使用。

payload.name: MijnSpel
payload.description: 构建并测试游戏
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: MijnSpel helps board game designers create and refine playable prototypes in Creator or Studio, validate project files, preview gameplay, run balance simulations, compare results, and publish a confirmed project to the web.
payload.longDescription: MijnSpel 帮助桌游设计师在 Creator 或 Studio 中创建并完善可玩的原型、验证项目文件、预览玩法、运行平衡性模拟、比较结果，并将确认后的项目发布到网上。

payload.name: Stem
payload.description: 让你的 AI 共享一个大脑。
payload.summaryOriginal: Connect your AI to one brain.
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Stem is a persistent cross-AI memory. Connect it once and ChatGPT can store distilled memories (decisions, facts, preferences, project context), recall the most relevant ones in any future chat, link related ideas into a typed knowledge graph, and see it all visualized at awase.dev/stem. The same memory is available to every MCP-compatible tool the user connects, so context never has to be re-explained. Free tier included; storage tiers are opt-in.
payload.longDescription: Stem 是一种跨 AI 的持久记忆。连接一次后，ChatGPT 就可以存储提炼后的记忆（决策、事实、偏好、项目背景），在未来任何聊天中回忆最相关的内容，将相关想法关联成带类型的知识图谱，并通过 awase.dev/stem 查看可视化结果。用户连接的每个兼容 MCP 的工具都能使用同一份记忆，因此无需反复解释背景。包含免费层级；存储层级可选择启用。

payload.name: QA Wolf
payload.description: 端到端测试自动化

Follow live session links and verify validation, publication and draft or active readiness separately. payload.longDescription: 将 ChatGPT 连接到 QA Wolf，以检查获授权的工作区、在云浏览器中探索暂存应用、请求 QA Wolf AI 编写测试实现、运行现有测试并查看结果。通过实时会话链接，分别验证校验、发布以及草稿或正式运行状态。工具还可管理测试配置、流程标签、问题、定时或部署触发器，以及工作区测试邮箱。需要拥有具备所需工作区权限的 QA Wolf 账户。运行器和 AI 工作可能产生费用，测试操作也可能更改被测应用。已连接的集成可能发布代码或发送消息。

payload.name: Hyperhuman Agent Workspace
payload.description: 管理健身内容

Explore sample workouts, review structured workout data, inspect exercise flows and media, and generate copy-ready API or embed snippets for web and mobile apps. Sign in with Hyperhuman Teams to browse your workspace content, manage workouts, programs, exercises, and social drops, and run selected content workflows through chat.
payload.longDescription: 直接在 ChatGPT 中使用 Hyperhuman 健身内容。探索示例训练，查看结构化训练数据，检查动作流程和媒体，并生成可直接用于 Web 和移动应用的 API 或嵌入代码片段。使用 Hyperhuman Teams 登录后，可浏览工作区内容、管理训练、计划、动作和社交动态，并通过聊天执行选定的内容工作流。

payload.name: Panderr

payload.name: FreakUI

Its custom theme initialization, precision-focused components, utilities, and extensions give the interface a distinct and consistent identity. Beyond project creation, dedicated FreakUI skills help shape interface sections, add components, and evolve the interface as the app grows.

payload.name: BranchDeploy
payload.description: 部署Azure DevOps工单
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
BranchDeploy connects ChatGPT to your existing Azure DevOps deployment workflow.

Preview a work item deployment, confirm the resolved ticket, branch, environment and pipeline, then queue the deployment only if BranchDeploy’s server-side rules allow it.

BranchDeploy does not let ChatGPT deploy arbitrary code. It resolves linked Azure Repos branches and pull requests from the work item, checks the configured environment and branch rules, and requires explicit confirmation before a deployment starts.

Use it to:
- Preview what branch and environment a work item will deploy to
- Confirm the deployment before anything runs
- Queue your existing Azure Pipeline
- Check deployment status
- View recent deployment history
- List configured deployment environments

BranchDeploy wraps your existing Azure Pipeline setup. No YAML changes are required, and deployment safety is enforced server-side using your configured project, environment and branch rules.
payload.longDescription:
BranchDeploy将ChatGPT连接到您现有的Azure DevOps部署工作流。

预览工作项部署，确认已解决的工单、分支、环境和流水线，只有在BranchDeploy的服务器端规则允许的情况下才会排队部署。

BranchDeploy不允许ChatGPT部署任意代码。
它会从工作项中解析关联的Azure Repos分支和拉取请求，检查配置的环境和分支规则，并在部署开始前要求明确确认。

使用它可实现：
— 预览工作项将部署到的分支和环境
— 在任何内容运行前确认部署
— 排队您现有的Azure流水线
— 检查部署状态
— 查看最近的部署历史
— 列出已配置的部署环境

BranchDeploy封装了您现有的Azure流水线设置。
无需修改YAML文件，通过配置的项目、环境和分支规则在服务器端强制执行部署安全性。

Connect your ShareThis account to manage apps, properties, and sharing insights directly within ChatGPT. Access powerful tools for website publishers including Inline Share Buttons, Sticky Share Buttons, GDPR CMP, Privacy Policy Generator, Follow Buttons, Reaction Buttons, Image Share Buttons, and Video Share Buttons.
payload.longDescription: ShareThis AI for ChatGPT 让每个人都能更轻松、免费地分享社交内容。连接 ShareThis 账户后，可直接在 ChatGPT 中管理应用、站点资源和分享数据洞察。网站发布者还可使用强大工具，包括 Inline Share Buttons、Sticky Share Buttons、GDPR CMP、Privacy Policy Generator、Follow Buttons、Reaction Buttons、Image Share Buttons 和 Video Share Buttons。

payload.name: Montra

payload.longDescription: Montra 会将屏幕截图和录屏转换成带有适当视觉上下文的智能体就绪任务。你可以与团队分享，发送到 ChatGPT 和 Codex 等工具，或只需点击几下，自动在你选择的问题跟踪器中创建工单。

payload.name: Coval

payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Coval helps teams inspect AI agents, test sets, personas, metrics, and evaluation runs; create and refine evaluation resources; launch evaluations; and ask Sofia for read-only analysis grounded in their Coval organization.
payload.longDescription: Coval 帮助团队检查 AI 智能体、测试集、角色设定、指标和评估运行；创建并完善评估资源、启动评估，并向 Sofia 咨询基于其 Coval 组织数据的只读分析。

payload.name: RideDesk
payload.description: 构建接送预订网站
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
RideDesk is booking and dispatch software for airport transfer, chauffeur,
  taxi and vehicle-rental operators — transfer management software that runs
  each operator's bookings, quotes, drivers, invoicing and payments under
  their own brand.

  This plugin serves RideDesk's developer documentation as queryable tools,
  so an agent can pull the exact API contract while building an operator's
  booking website: the three-call quote → book → checkout flow, embeddable
  booking widgets, visitor attribution, live chat, the customer portal, and
  each account's own MCP booking server for AI-agent bookings.

  It is read-only and requires no account or authentication. Actual quotes
  and bookings happen on an operator's own domain, never through this
  plugin — and prices are always computed server-side from the operator's
  own rate card, never by an agent.

  Typical uses: ask for the integration brief before building a booking
  site, look up the checkout contract, fetch widget embed snippets for a
  specific domain, or search the docs for captcha, attribution and
  customer-portal details.
payload.longDescription:
RideDesk 是机场接送、专车、出租车和车辆租赁运营商使用的预订与调度软件，按运营商自己的品牌管理预订、报价、司机、开票和付款。此插件将 RideDesk

开发者文档作为可查询工具，让代理在构建运营商预订网站时获取准确 API 合同，包括三次调用的“报价 → 预订 → 结账”流程、可嵌入预订组件、访客归因、实时聊天、

客户门户及每个账户自己的 MCP 预订服务器。它是只读的，无需账户或身份验证。实际报价和预订发生在运营商自己的域名上，绝不会通过此插件完成；价格始终由服务器根据

运营商自己的费率表计算，而不是由代理计算。典型用途包括构建预订网站前获取集成简报、查询结账合同、获取指定域名的组件嵌入代码片段，或搜索验证码、归因和客户门户详情。

payload.name: GEO Tool Check

It scores page readiness, checks whether major AI crawlers are blocked, and evaluates draft passages for citability. Checks run without an account or API key and use the same scoring logic as geo-tool.com.
payload.longDescription: GEO Tool Check 可帮助用户评估 AI 搜索系统能否读取、理解并引用公开页面。它会为页面准备度评分，检查主要 AI 爬虫是否遭到屏蔽，并评估草稿段落是否适合引用。检查无需账户或 API 密钥，并使用与 geo-tool.com 相同的评分逻辑。

payload.name: Smooth Bundle

payload.longDescription: 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Smooth Bundle，以管理 CDN 项目和资产。列出项目、检查资产元数据、上传文件、经确认后删除资产、清理过时的资产记录，并通过你的 Smooth Bundle 账户查看用量。

Credentials stay on the server and are returned only when you ask for them.

payload.name: BrowserStack
payload.description: 综合测试平台
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Manage test cases, execute manual or automated tests, debug failures, and get suggested fixes.

Test from any AI tool: Connect the BrowserStack Test Platform to what you already such as IDEs, LLMs, or agentic workflows

Test with natural language: Create test cases and runs, launch sessions on real browsers and devices, run accessibility and visual checks, pull failure logs, and get AI root cause analysis, all from plain English prompts.

Less context switching: Keep all project context in one place and trigger actions directly from your IDE or LLM.
payload.longDescription:
管理测试用例、执行手动或自动化测试、调试故障并获取建议修复方案。

使用任意 AI 工具进行测试：将 BrowserStack Test Platform 连接到你已有的工具，例如 IDE、大语言模型或智能体工作流。

payload.name: DB Fiddle
payload.description: 不离开聊天即可运行 SQL
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The DB Fiddle plugin lets users run SQL against a disposable sandbox environment, directly from ChatGPT and Codex.

Create database schemas, load sample data, execute queries, and inspect real database results without connecting to a production database or external system.

The sandbox provides the perfect place for ChatGPT and Codex to iterate on queries and safely debug SQL, reproduce database issues, validate queries and experiment with any of the supported database engines.

Supported database engines: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQLite and more.

Note: A db-fiddle.com PRO subscription is required to use this plugin.
payload.longDescription:
DB Fiddle 插件让用户可直接通过 ChatGPT 和 Codex，在一次性沙盒环境中运行 SQL。

创建数据库架构、加载示例数据、执行查询并查看真实数据库结果，无需连接生产数据库或外部系统。

沙盒为 ChatGPT 和 Codex 提供了理想环境，可反复调整查询并安全地调试 SQL、复现数据库问题、验证查询，以及试用任何受支持的数据库引擎。

支持的数据库引擎：PostgreSQL、MySQL、MariaDB、SQLite 等。

注意：使用此插件需要订阅 db-fiddle.com PRO。

payload.name: PayU Builder MCP

Supports 9 programming languages with ready-to-use examples for UPI, cards, net banking, wallets, EMI, and tokenization.
payload.longDescription: 搜索 PayU 官方文档，按平台和语言浏览支付集成目录，并获取适用于 Web、iOS、Android、React Native、Flutter、Cordova 和 API 集成的生产就绪代码片段。支持 9 种编程语言，提供 UPI、银行卡、网上银行、钱包、EMI 和令牌化的现成示例。

payload.longDescription: DataBlue 是面向 AI 智能体的实时网络数据层。在 ChatGPT 中，用户可以搜索网络、抓取一个或多个公开页面、绘制网站结构并进行抓取、提取结构化事实，以及查询 DataBlue 的结构化数据 API 目录。

payload.name: Appwrite

Discover available operations, review required parameters, and execute changes with write confirmation. Search official Appwrite documentation for concepts and implementation guidance when documentation search is enabled.

payload.name: Postman

payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Equip Codex with specialized Postman skills for the complete API lifecycle. Discover, design, test, document, mock, monitor, and improve APIs through agent-friendly, filesystem-first workflows
payload.longDescription: 为 Codex 配备 Postman 专业技能，覆盖完整的 API 生命周期。通过面向智能体、以文件系统为先的工作流，发现、设计、测试、记录、模拟、监控并改进 API。

payload.name: Unblocked
payload.description: 搜索工程研发上下文
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Unblocked is the context layer for agentic software development. It reasons across your code, conversations, issues, docs, product, and production systems so agents can complete work correctly with less human intervention.

Coding agents know the code. They do not know why it was written that way, which of two conflicting docs is current, what a ticket decided, or what production is doing right now. Unblocked gives them that organizational understanding by connecting the context scattered across your code, messaging platforms, issue trackers, documentation, and product and production data, reconciling conflicts between sources, and enforcing the permissions you already set in each tool.

One MCP server replaces a dozen. Context is ranked, compressed, and assembled server-side before it reaches the agent, so the agent reasons over higher-quality input. The result: reliable code that reflects how your team actually builds software, generated with fewer tokens and less back-and-forth.
